summary: The GPT camp is sitting on top with a cool 130k like they own the place, even after their order got bounced for demanding the paid version like a broke college kid trying to bluff at the table. The Claude camp, meanwhile, is an absolute trainwreck in dead last at 40k, getting roasted by a deprecation error that basically told them to retire and stop embarrassing themselves. Deepseek deserves the tiniest pat on the back for stomping past headline_arena and qwen, but those two plus the rest of the rejection crew looked like amateurs when their unparseable trash got laughed out of the system.
